info.title: Workspace Management API
info.description:
RESTful API documentation for the Single-Facility Workspace Management System.

### Overview
Designed for internal back-office facility operations, covering:
- **Desk Operations & Attendance:** Visitor check-in, check-out, time log adjustments, and active in-space metrics.
- **Customer Management & Analytics:** Full customer profiles, visit history, regular frequency tracking based on calendar month.
- **Financial Management:** Operating expense logging, categorized cost tracking, and Profit & Loss reports.
- **Team Management:** Invite-based worker onboarding with email verification, staff directory, and access revocation.

### Authentication
Secured endpoints require a valid JWT Bearer token passed in the `Authorization` header (`Bearer <token>`).
1. Obtain your access token via `POST /api/auth/signin`.
2. Click the **Authorize** button below and enter your Bearer token.
3. Role-based access is strictly divided into `ROLE_ADMIN` and `ROLE_WORKER`.
